text: laden: Heb. of heaviness | gone away backward: Heb. alienated, or seperated
revolt more and more: Heb. increase revolt
as overthrown by strangers: Heb. as the overthrow of strangers
he goats: Heb. great he goats
to appear: Heb. to be seen
make many prayers: Heb. multiply prayer | blood: Heb. bloods
her converts: Or, they that return of her
and the maker: Or, and his work
